summary_en: AOYAMA TRADING authorized acquisition of up to 5.8 million shares or 4 billion yen, representing 4.04% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 to March 24, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency under its medium-term plan.
title_en: Notice regarding decisions on interim dividend and acquisition of treasury stock (Acquisition of treasury stock based on articles of incorporation under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, AOYAMA TRADING's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 5.8 million shares of its common stock with a maximum expenditure of 4 billion yen. This acquisition, representing 4.04% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock (143.65 million shares as of September 30, 2026), will be executed through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 through March 24, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, consistent with its shareholder return policy defined in the medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ending March 2025 through March 2027. The acquisition is conducted under the framework of Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act as provided in the company's articles of incorporation.
